```yaml
name: Smoke Tests - Mastodon Interoperability

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - next
      - '*.*-maintenance'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  smoke-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [18]

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js ${{ matrix.node-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build Fedify
        run: npm run build

      - name: Start Mastodon stack and Fedify harness
        run: |
          cd test/smoke/mastodon
          docker compose up -d

      - name: Wait for services to be ready
        run: |
          cd test/smoke/mastodon
          timeout 120 bash -c 'until docker compose exec -T web curl -f http://localhost:3000/_test/health; do sleep 5; done'

      - name: Run smoke tests
        run: |
          cd test/smoke
          deno run --allow-net --allow-read orchestrator.ts

      - name: Stop services
        if: always()
        run: |
          cd test/smoke/mastodon
          docker compose down -v

      - name: Upload test results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: smoke-test-results
          path: test/smoke/mastodon/test-results.xml
          retention-days: 7
```
